summary.text: CASY AS is a private limited company registered in Asker, founded 1999-01-18. CASY AS imports and produces packaging and trades in packaging and related goods, and also participates in other companies and carries on other business connected to this. Its statutory purpose includes buying and selling commercial kitchen equipment, packing machines, packaging and solutions for food distribution, as well as buying and selling other companies with the same purpose. It was previously named CASY CATERING SYSTEMS AS until 2021-08-26. Its main industry code is 46.860: wholesale of other intermediate products. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 18 126 612 NOK and the annual result was 227 081 NOK; operating income was up from 17 027 111 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 192 209 NOK in 2024 to 227 081 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 654 140 NOK in 2024 to 2 864 672 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is casy.no. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-22 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).

sentences.text: CASY AS is a private limited company registered in Asker, founded 1999-01-18.

It was previously named CASY CATERING SYSTEMS AS until 2021-08-26.
Its main industry code is 46.860: wholesale of other intermediate products.

The annual result rose from 192 209 NOK in 2024 to 227 081 NOK in 2025.
Equity rose from 2 654 140 NOK in 2024 to 2 864 672 NOK in 2025.
